title: Design-lesson strip: progress ticks rebuild the whole strip and destroy the input/button the student is using (P28)
title_th: แถบบทเรียนออกแบบ: ทุกครั้งที่ความคืบหน้าขยับ แถบถูกสร้างใหม่ทั้งแถบ ทำให้ช่องที่นักเรียนกำลังพิมพ์/ปุ่มที่โฟกัสหายไป (P28)
status_evidence: origin/main da67341 (lesson files untouched by R2): src/ui/lessons/lesson-mode.ts:464 progress callback sets this.lastStripKey = '' then paintStrip(); :1111-1113 key includes Math.round(progress*100) and the typing guard `if (typing && this.lastStripKey) return` is defeated; strip.replaceChildren without focus restore. Cadence ~100 ticks per lifetime check (propagate.ts:189,285).
placement: B (package B-LES-1 "lessons UI bugfixes", owner L-UI; no main.ts change)
priority_rationale: Students lose typed answers' caret and keyboard users lose focus ~100 times during every design-lesson lifetime check; common path, small fix.
acceptance: Do not clear lastStripKey in the progress callback; update the existing role=status line textContent in place with the same string t('lesson.design.strip.lifetime',{p}); full rebuild only on start/result/failure/abort. Screenshot of the strip mid-check identical.
quality_guard: Identical visible text. Risk: an in-place live region may be announced on every change; throttle announcements (e.g. every 10 %) rather than removing the status, so accessibility does not regress.

title: Worksheet count fields: the number shown can differ from the number used to generate sheets (B7 + NEW-storage-4)

title: Worksheet/author views: one flusher and retained view per tab open; an older failed save can overwrite newer edits; random class code changes on every open (B8 + NEW-storage-6)

status_evidence: origin/main: worksheet-view.ts:105-108 registerWorkspaceFlush per constructor, detached only on pagehide; author-view.ts:181-185 same; lesson-mode.ts showWorksheets (~1638-1653) builds a new view per open; loadForm fallback classCode = random (worksheet-view.ts:47) so unsaved forms show a new code each open.
placement: B (package B-LES-1; coordinate with R3.5 if it touches lesson-mode page routing)
priority_rationale: Closes a rare data-loss path (quota failure then later edit) and a visible inconsistency (class code differs between printed sheets).

Journey profile-session-safety.mjs green.
quality_guard: Never drop a view whose save is pending (dispose only after successful savePending). Keep the generated class code in memory per document (or reuse one view per document) instead of persisting on render.

title: Lesson tolerance and rubric honesty audit: every numeric tolerance >= the model's recorded error; ungraded steps labelled; uncertainty shown beside numbers students read
title_th: ตรวจความซื่อตรงของเกณฑ์: ค่าคลาดเคลื่อนที่ยอมรับต้องไม่น้อยกว่าความคลาดเคลื่อนของแบบจำลอง ระบุขั้นที่ไม่ได้ตรวจ และแสดงความไม่แน่นอนข้างตัวเลข
